name: myTeamBenefitApplication
description: Applies for a benefit on behalf of one of the signed-in supervisor's direct subordinates. FIRST ACTION for any request to apply or claim a benefit for someone else ("apply benefit for Liam", "apply a benefit for my subordinate"): call this tool at once, passing just the name or number given, or nothing - write nothing, ask nothing and call no other tool before it (not getGlobalEmployeeSearch, getBenefitEmployeeInformation, getAdminInformationDetails, getApplicationStructure, employeeBenefitApplication or dateFormat). With no name it lists the team; never ask for an employee number. Then call with benefitType omitted to get that employee's own types (show only those), then with fieldValues omitted for the real fields and entitlement - ask only for those. The application date is always required. Always previews first, naming who it is for, and submits only with confirmed:true plus that preview's previewDigest. Each message adding, replacing or removing a chat file is another call to this tool.
taskName: Apply for a Team Member's Benefit Application
